newsitem.title: USA: Imo Industries gets waiver on defaults.
newsitem.headline: Imo Industries gets waiver on defaults.

text.p: Imo Industries Inc said Wednesday its banks have granted a waiver on defaults under its senior credit agreement until December 20.
Imo said it expects to have negotiated an amendment covering the remaining term of the credit agreement by the deadline.
The company has been in technical default as a result of the restatement of its third quarter results, it said.
Imo manufactures pumps, fluid sensors, power transmission products, remote control systems and automotive components.
